title: RID leak when using `Search Help`
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.6.3.stable, 4.7.rc df6235838b63dd49f448547406e339848455c140 (current master)

### System information

Godot v4.6.3.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080 SUPER (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9186) - AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 63.11 GiB memory

### Issue description

Closing Godot after searching for something in `Search Help` I get warnings like this. The amount of leaked RIDs changes depending on how often `Search Help` is used and what is searched.
```
ERROR: 880 RID allocations of type 'PN18TextServerAdvanced22ShapedTextDataAdvancedE' were leaked at exit.
WARNING: ObjectDB instances leaked at exit (run with --verbose for details).
   at: cleanup (core/object/object.cpp:2663)
Leaked instance: DPITexture:9223372080005777421 - Reference count: 117
Leaked instance: DPITexture:9223372080039331855 - Reference count: 102
Leaked instance: DPITexture:9223372080056109072 - Reference count: 1
Leaked instance: TreeItem:1741592534295
Leaked instance: TextParagraph:9223373778464087320 - Reference count: 1
Leaked instance: TextParagraph:9223373778480864537 - Reference count: 1
Leaked instance: TreeItem:1741642865946
Leaked instance: TextParagraph:9223373778514418971 - Reference count: 1
Leaked instance: TextParagraph:9223373778531196188 - Reference count: 1
Leaked instance: TreeItem:1743555468684
Leaked instance: TextParagraph:9223373780427021709 - Reference count: 1
...
```

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create new project and open it through a console to see outputs
2. Go to `Script` and open `Search Help`
3. Type something (for example just `a`)
4. Close `Search Help` and Godot
5. The console used to open should now contain the error
